param_1.name: Wait Cycle
param_1.description:
Delay between coin gates. Note that this value is not in frames. This value also affects its respawn timer.
If 0, the pokey does not respawn! When coin gates are not desired, use a very high initial delay instead.

4042.name: KaraPillar
4042.description:
A desert pillar that can fall after some period of time. It briefly shakes before it falls. Drivers hit by the pillar while it is falling are spun out.
Some sand particles are spawned when the pillar finishes falling (GCN Dry Dry Desert's ptcl required).
Only one side is trickable/drivable, the other sides act as walls.
This object should not be scaled, as the pillar and the base are scaled from their own separate origins!
